notes: Refresh only while GeneralRouter is in use. The first active request fetches once; subsequent active refresh requests share a ten-minute cache. Idle hosts do not poll. Failed collection attempts are also throttled for ten minutes.
Read enabled credential metadata and each credential's actual models from the ECPA management interface. Do not manually create quota groups or infer AA-to-provider model mappings.

Match an already user-mapped callable model ID exactly against the reported credential model IDs. Multiple possible credentials are kept as evidence; GeneralRouter does not claim to pin which credential ECPA will use.
Only provider-reported percentages are used. There is no assumed five-percent cost per job, safety-margin deduction, percentage reservation, or settlement hold.
Codex shared primary and secondary windows constrain a known account. Additional and code-review windows remain visible without assuming that every normal model call consumes them.

Antigravity reported display labels are preserved for display. They do not prove a model-ID association; where the source does not report that relation, applicability remains unknown and GeneralRouter does not guess it.

Known applicable allowance must be strictly greater than minimum_remaining_percent. Unknown allowance, unmatched model IDs, API-key routes, stale snapshots and unsupported collectors remain explicitly unknown and do not block the user's paid API calls.

A route is rejected for a reported percentage only if all exact matching credential evidence is known and at or below the configured minimum. At least one known positive credential permits dispatch; unknown alternatives prevent a claim that every usable credential is exhausted.

Dispatch tickets retain task and route identity atomically for tracking. They never subtract an estimated allowance. Percentages cannot guarantee that a long task or another client will not exhaust a shared account.

The management key environment variable takes precedence. A private connection.management_key_toml_file may point to the existing ECPA config.toml; only root management-secret-key is used in memory. Python 3.11 or newer is required for this optional TOML source.
Select the installed management_api_version explicitly as v0 or v8. The collector never downloads OAuth credential files and never runs model health-check requests.
